items.title: Results posted for a study of Kcentra for Heart Disease End Stage
items.summary: University of Maryland, Baltimore ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 14 people. It was stopped early. The study team’s reason: “Standard practice change prohibited enrollment”. The registry lists its end date as 20 Feb 2025. The study team posted its results on ClinicalTrials.gov. Our search of PubMed and Europe PMC for this study’s number (NCT03341156) found no journal article. Searches can miss articles, so one may already exist. We don’t say here whether the treatment worked. The official study record has the full results.
